no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not taken to a meeting of the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee. The Office of Oncology Drug Products has accepted the endpoint of progression-free survival as an approval endpoint and the toxicity profile is similar to that of other cytotoxic drugs.

summary: No Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) meeting was convened for the ixabepilone (IXEMPRA) application; both the Office Director memo and the Medical Review state the application was not taken to ODAC because the Office of Oncology Drug Products had accepted progression-free survival as an approval endpoint and the toxicity profile resembled other cytotoxic drugs. In lieu of a meeting, FDA individually consulted one standing ODAC member (Dr. Joanne Mortimer) about the PFS endpoint and the myelosuppression/neuropathy findings, but no committee meeting or vote occurred. Because no advisory committee was held, there are no committee-to-change linkages.
